mainQuestion: 按照当前最新的伊朗战争形态，这场战争最可能以哪种形式平息或结束？
decompositionStrategy: Cover the live conflict through facts, causes, impacts, evidence, risks, and falsification checks.
missingInfo: current date/time for the conflict state

subQuestions.title: Final outcome
subQuestions.questionText: 综合所有因素，最终战争最可能怎么结束？
subQuestions.purpose: This improperly asks for the final synthesis.
subQuestions.scope: Includes final synthesis, which should be rejected.

subQuestions.title: Current facts
subQuestions.questionText: What verified events define the current conflict state?
subQuestions.scope: Include current verified events; exclude final outcome prediction.

subQuestions.title: Drivers
subQuestions.questionText: Which drivers explain escalation or de-escalation pressure?
subQuestions.scope: Include drivers and incentives; exclude final probability.

subQuestions.title: Regional impact
subQuestions.questionText: Which regional impacts would change escalation incentives?
subQuestions.scope: Include regional effects; exclude operational instructions.

subQuestions.title: Evidence reliability
subQuestions.questionText: Which sources are reliable enough to establish the conflict shape?
subQuestions.scope: Include source quality; exclude final synthesis.
